sql_diagnosis.scope: Fresh owned PG/synthetic10000/one DjangoClient request, lightweight SQL wrapper only, no rule profiler/post_init. Not strictly equivalent to full matrix or concurrent workers; excludes network/fixtures. Parameters never stored; plan strings/literals redact via SQL normalizer. SQL execute contains client binding/driver/server/buffering; excludes subsequent fetch. EXPLAIN selects after request, warmed OS/PG caches, READ ONLY transaction; plan actual rows describe per-node streams and loops, not rows_scanned/request. No pg_stat_statements or config change.
sql_diagnosis.not_measured: rows_returned; rows_affected; rows_scanned; DB CPU/RSS/waits/locks/IO; materialization; validation/render exclusive; causal overhead; concurrent capacity

controlled_content_profile.scope: One PG population10000; only descriptions/alternative descriptions and Telegram change. All other concrete fields/counts of listings/core/catalog/mediafiles hashed before and after each variant. Controls precede profiler; one sample, warmed caches, no causal overhead estimate. Nonwrapping synchronous sys.setprofile including deepcopy/model_to_dict/construct_instance; exclusive discounts direct observed children once, unobserved SQL/lazy work remains inside parent. Same body/route/count for control versus profile, not native eligibility equivalence or capacity gate.
controlled_content_profile.not_measured: SQL time/normalized SQL; DB CPU; SQL rows; native full-population equivalence; causal overhead; worker queue; concurrent capacity

scope_limitations: Original fixed_population excludes automatic M2M models; their cardinalities/hash invariance not_measured in that run
Inherited rules are aggregated by code, not form class; per-class evaluation counters are observed but their exclusive times cannot be allocated by subtraction
Profile content descriptors cover all approved revisions, not just the10000 public candidates
SQL wrapper is only in separate SQL case; SQL/count metrics not_measured within controlled rule profiles
Native full-population equivalence not proved by control/profile equality alone; auxiliary audit required
